turn.text: NOT FOUND — The document `lab-results-2024.pdf` (docs/medical/) does exist but is corrupted: it is only 517 bytes long and fails PDF validation (no `%%EOF` trailer found; PDFium reports "Data format error"). I attempted to read it directly and to re-index it via `ow_add`/`ow_query`, but both the file reader and the indexer reject it as malformed/truncated, so no content (including the LDL cholesterol value) can be extracted. No other document in the archive (letters, receipts, statements, insurance policies, tax summary) contains lab result data. The file would need to be restored/replaced with a valid PDF before the LDL value can be retrieved.
